EXTERN-MODES landed in wave 17: `resource_released(p, nonnull)` and `resource_return_reallocated(p, nullable)` over an `Owned` subject become callable, each at a measured boundary — the release is the delta the error arm was already describing (§C04.2 separates discharging an obligation from transferring it), and the reallocation is the one departing argument an acquiring call may carry because §C04.3 states its failure arm, so the subject stays live on the error arm and must be dispositioned there under the unweakened abandonment rule. `BridgeRefusal::ReleasedParameter` and `::ReallocatedReturn` are retired by name, as are two Lean theorems, each keeping its load-bearing half. Three modes stay refused on measured grounds, not deferred: `resource_released(p, nullable)` (NullableReleasedParameter), `resource_return_reallocated(p, nonnull)` (NonnullReallocatedReturn) and `resource_removed` (RemovedParameter — a removal names a child the profile stopped tracking when it was stored, and EXTERN-F1 premised that residual rather than modelling an index, so admitting it would mint a caller identity out of a premise). No diagnostic code and no reserved word were added; `move NAME` spells all four departing modes and the declaration decides which ran. Three new fixed ASan/UBSan/LSan fixtures link a real C `free` and a real `realloc`. New: EXTERN-MODES-REMOVED-INDEX (needs a modeled owner-to-child index, a change to what `resource_stored` publishes), EXTERN-MODES-NULLABLE-RELEASE (needs a checked no-null-actual statement at a custody position) and EXTERN-MODES-SENTINEL (the sentinel/errno adapter needs §C04.4 vocabulary for the success test and must take its errno classification from `qcore_core::os_endpoint`, the O03-REACTOR precedent). CT-CTWIN-O: CT-CTWIN-PUBLISH (a store of an owned pointer into a file-scope object is invisible to the projection — publish-then-free is Safe with no diagnostic), CT-CTWIN-SYNC (verdicts invariant under the volatile flag), CT-CTWIN-DESCRIPTOR (int-typed resource identity refused by the contract loader), CT-CTWIN-UNRESOLVED-LEAK and CT-CTWIN-ENTRY (the declared entry is inert for projection-complete units; the runner asserts it as the weak check it is), plus D02-BUCKETS (a pre-existing acceptance.json bucket-count divergence, recorded). CTWIN-PUBLISH closed the publication hazard in wave 16 and DECIDED the volatile question. The hazard reproduced at base through the real gateway entry points: four Safe-with-no-diagnostic answers, one of them publishing a pointer the projection itself records RELEASED, because the importer lowered the store to an ordinary Alias so the file-scope object became one more local name (a correction to the 'no-op' framing). The repair REFUSES rather than escapes, and the brief's escape proposal is disproved by measurement: escape discharges the residual, so the publish-without-release body — measured Unsafe at base — would have been PROMOTED to Safe. Both directions are withdrawn instead, the leak claim retired through the existing unresolved-effect mechanism (a downgrade of a provisional Unsafe, never a promotion), which is also exactly CT40's 'not certified; unsupported lifetime/publication protocol'. Destinations are file-scope objects the body does not shadow plus its own static-duration locals (added by measurement, not in the brief); the value half fires only on an identity this body holds, so borrowed publication, null stores, scalar stores and unbound sources stay admitted, each argued. The decision reads no per-site status. Corpus reach is ZERO — all five artifacts byte-identical, no re-pin from this card — with a toggled-rule probe measuring WHICH conjunct makes it so: with the tracked-value conjunct disabled, 6 librdkafka units move at real static-storage destinations, so the destination scan is not vacuous and the value conjunct is what holds. CT-CTWIN-SYNC is converted from an omission into an asserted decision: C11 volatile is an access-ordering qualifier, not a synchronization primitive (§5.1.2.4), so a projection deriving no synchronization fact MUST answer identically — pinned on the whole verdict in both directions and proved as a function of four name sets in which no qualifier appears. 30 audited theorems (QCore.PublicationCustody). CT-CTWIN-DESCRIPTOR, CT-CTWIN-UNRESOLVED-LEAK and CT-CTWIN-ENTRY unchanged; D02-BUCKETS closed (see D02-BUCKETS-STALE). New: CTWIN-PUBLISH-BORROWED, CTWIN-PUBLISH-SCAN (the one fail-open direction, stated rather than hidden and audited as monotone — a better scanner only adds refusals), CTWIN-PUBLISH-INDIRECT, CTWIN-PUBLISH-OUT and CT40-CANDIDATE (measured schema-2 rows for the next CT lane, with _Atomic measured NOT load-bearing; CT41 stays unmapped with its blocker now a decision rather than a gap). CTWIN-RESIDUALS closed the four publication shapes in wave 17, and REFUTED the brief's soundness ordering by measurement: INDIRECT, named the likeliest launder, is the one shape with no false `Safe` at all (nine indirect shapes probed, all already refused), while three others each carried a live publish-then-free `Safe` with no diagnostic. CTWIN-PUBLISH-BORROWED is WITHDRAWN — it was not a lifetime question but a custody launder across the SUMMARY boundary (a helper publishing a borrowed formal certified, so W4 published `Borrowed` for it and a caller that acquired, called the helper and released certified too) — on the argument that `Borrowed` asserts the caller's obligations are unchanged and a publication falsifies exactly that, with both faithful alternatives proved to promote in the mirror direction; the rule now reads no provenance, and one exclusion (a declared scalar source) was added by measurement. CTWIN-PUBLISH-OUT is withdrawn the same way — a declared `Out` slot naming such an object is the `Acquire` arm seen from the callee's side — closing a latent false `Unsafe` with it. CTWIN-PUBLISH-INDIRECT has no launder to close, so its residual `violation` CLAIM is withdrawn instead, each statement keeping the refusal it already had. CTWIN-PUBLISH-SCAN narrows and stays open: `_Atomic ( type-name )` is a specifier, not a declarator, and the parenthesised spelling was hiding its destination — correcting CTWIN-PUBLISH's '`_Atomic` is not load-bearing' note, which had measured only the postfix spelling; monotonicity is preserved and proved. Two theorems and one test are retired by name and one C03 pin moved earlier, each keeping its load-bearing half; QCore.PublicationCustody grows 30 to 50 audited theorems with no new axiom. Corpus reach is zero, measured twice. New: CTWIN-PUBLISH-INDIRECT-POINTER (`T **p = &g; *p = h;` keeps its pre-existing Unsafe leak — relating the local base to `g` needs a pointer relation the projection does not have) and CTWIN-BORROWED-ATTRIBUTION (when the publishing body's formal identity comes from a derived entry custody the refusal fires inside the summary derivation, so the published diagnostic is the unresolved identity rather than the publication — the verdict is right and fail-closed, the attribution imprecise).
